name: com.bizsim.google.play.review
description: Unity package for Google Play In-App Review API (v2.0.2). Smart trigger engine with configurable thresholds, remote kill switch, GDPR consent gate, diagnostic snapshots, cooldown management, and Firebase telemetry adapter.

samples.description: Minimal review request with local cooldown, callback, async, and coroutine-bootstrap examples.
IReviewAnalyticsAdapterV2 implementation logging all 15 review events to Firebase Analytics.
IFeedbackSink implementation that appends feedback as JSON lines to persistentDataPath.
Pre-configured ReviewSettings for casual, hardcore, and utility apps.
